text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—I received the social media management data.
I'll look over it later.
choice_data_list: Yes, I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.text:
Breathing a sigh of relief, I give a deep stretch.
...Putting this together between my training duties was quite the ordeal.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
This is a good stopping point, so you should take a short break.
You've been working non-stop since morning, after all.
choice_data_list: Ah, no! If anything, rather than me—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sirius has training this afternoon, doesn't she?
Never mind that, just focus on your main job.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry about me.
As you know, I am confident in my stamina.
choice_data_list: As expected of a legend... Then take this!

text_block_list.text:
I pulled a sweet bun out of my bag and handed it to her.
I had prepared it just in case someone got peckish.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Thank you for the thought.
I shall enjoy it later.
Speed Symboli used to say things like that, but...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You've finished the whole training menu.
Go grab some food, then meet in the conference room.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh?

Inside the room where we had been working all morning,
Speed Symboli was still standing there, unchanged.
Near her hands as she focused, the bread and other refreshments I had given her remained completely untouched.
choice_data_list: ...So legendary Umamusume have good fuel efficiency too, huh?
...So legendary Umamusume have good fuel efficiency too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Idiot.
As if that'd ever happen.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hey.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "It's just leftovers. Take a little care of your aging body, Grand Senpai."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you.
Though, isn't calling me an 'old timer' a bit harsh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha.
Rich coming from someone too exhausted to even eat properly.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about it normally, there's no way it's fine
to keep working without eating anything, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Putting them on a pedestal as a "Legendary Umamusume"
is why people misjudge them.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll be rewriting that legend with these legs before long.
Stop clinging to relics of the past.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh.
...Harsh words, but reassuring nonetheless.
Her attitude toward Speed Symboli suddenly made complete sense.

There is no filter whatsoever.
In the eyes of Sirius Symboli.

"Whether my opponent is a living legend or anyone else,
I hold an unwavering belief that I am the best."
choice_data_list: Sirius is gonna become a legend... after all
Sirius is gonna become a legend, you know...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Hmph.
(*Snap*)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
For your punishment this time,
I'll let you off with a forehead flick.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Just never mistake who your master is
ever again, little puppy.

I look into Sirius Symboli's eyes and nod firmly.
Her face, overflowing with confidence, shone the brightest of all.
